what: PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I, lead analyst synthesis (lenses conviction, clock, weights and the attack on V05). IN SAMPLE ONLY: price frames read with the parquet row filter ts < 2022-01-01; official trades read with entry_time < 2022-01-01 in the same statement; nothing dated 2022 or later is read, simulated or looked at.
written_utc: 2026-11-12T15:03:00Z, before any simulation or computation of this synthesis

why: The three lenses report no candidate under the criteria fixed in Addendum I. clock: 9 declared rules x0.933 to x1.000 pooled weekly Sharpe at equal swing (FP). weights: 15 variants, best IV00 x1.059 (fails (a)). conviction: best V05 x1.095 (fails (a), x1.10 required).

V05 is the only change with a verdict (weakened). As declared (training trades with exit_time <= 1 January Y minus 7 days) it fails criterion (a): x1.0951 (lens and verifier). The verifier's strict reading of rule 3 (exit strictly before the cutoff) gives x1.1002: a reading chosen after the result, passing by 0.0002 because of two trades whose time exits fall on the cutoff instant (2018-12-25 00:00 UTC); a pass on a post hoc reading by that margin is not a pass of the pre-registered test.

Addendum H already keeps K1 on brk72_24h_wd ethusd (same descriptor riskbp) and allows at most one change per sleeve; the verifier finds V05 on top of K1 at x1.056 with 2019 down (x0.980): it fails (a) and (b) as an addition to what H keeps.

Criterion (b) is fragile (2019 x1.006; down with the live Friday close x0.997, on the capped account x0.990, on top of K1 x0.980); the earlier 2018 fold goes the other way (x0.944); on the user's 1,000 EUR account at today's prices it lowers the weekly Sharpe (x0.954 at 1 % risk, x0.993 at 2 %). The verifier recommends not carrying it.
The workflow rule keeps ONLY changes whose verdict is confirmed or weakened with a positive effect: a necessary condition, not a sufficient one; the candidate criteria of Addendum I remain binding.
kept_set_decision.consequence: The account of the ten sleeves with the kept changes of Addendum I is the unchanged account. The simulations below are information: they re-measure, with the simulator and this synthesis's own code, the reference, the dropped near-miss, and what Addendum H keeps, on the measures of Addendum I. Their results cannot add a change to the kept set. If my re-implementation of V05 differs from the lens and the verifier by more than 0.002 in the pooled ratio, I report the discrepancy instead of re-deciding.

account: PLAIN SUM of the one-position chains of the sleeves (no 6-position / 2-per-market caps, no compounding), 1 R per trade times the stake; kept the same throughout. Chains: orders of the frozen rules from lab/r2/recalc.py::sleeves() on the in-sample slice, simulated with no_overlap, orders whose stop is closer than 3 spreads of the fill bar refused (sleeve re-simulated), trades still open at the end of the slice dropped.
weeks: FP server weeks (New York + 7 h, Monday to Sunday); stake x R booked in the week of the EXIT; every calendar week counts (empty = 0). Out-of-fold window: the 157 server weeks whose Thursday falls in 2019, 2020 or 2021; a week belongs to the year of its Thursday. Weekly Sharpe = mean / sd (ddof 1) x sqrt(52).
equal_swing: each variant's stakes are multiplied by k = sd(reference weekly R) / sd(variant weekly R) over the 157 out-of-fold weeks (same cost mode); every measure of the variant is then read at that scale. Per-year figures use the same k.
measures: pooled 2019-2021 and by year, FP costs and costs x1.5 (the whole procedure re-run on the x1.5 frames: chains, fits, thresholds, reference): trades (taken trades whose exit week is in the window), R per trade at equal swing (total / trades), euros earned per 100 euros risked (100 x sum(stake x R) / sum(stake)), weekly Sharpe and its ratio to the reference, total R, share of losing weeks, worst week, longest run of losing weeks, losing trades per month (36 months pooled, 12 per year), deepest fall of the weekly cumulative R.

Negative control: a price read 2 minutes after the decision must differ on the cut frame for most decisions.
